d:
The race for gold gets more intense as the miners face tough challenges and unexpected setbacks. In this episode, Rick outperforms Parker on his new Indian River claim, Tony Beets faces a catastrophic failure of his dredge, and Todd Hoffman's remaining crew finally strikes good gold at their Colorado mine. With fortunes at stake and challenges mounting, who will come out on top?
Watch Gold Rush, Season 7, Episode 14, on Discovery Channel India.
